title: Sect Competition
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped onto the arena platform, Han Lie was howling arrogantly below the stage, while the turtle shell in his embrace suddenly burned with unbearable heat, as if something was about to break free...

text.content:
Dusk fell, and the Mountain Path of the Tianqing Sect was filled with a faint scent of pine and lingering medicinal herbs. Su Qingyao's grip on Chen Ji's arm tightened imperceptibly—she could feel the异样 heat radiating from the thin figure beneath his robes. It was the turtle shell agitation.

Chen Ji's gaze swept past the girl's shoulder toward the distant cliff. There was nothing there, but he knew someone had indeed been watching him just moments ago. That feeling of being observed was like a silver needle in winter, piercing into the back of his neck and slowly descending along his spine.

"Chen Ji, are you alright?" Su Qingyao's voice carried a rare hint of urgency. "Your body temperature..."

"I'm fine." Chen Ji gently pulled away from the girl's hand, a faint, cold smile curving his lips. "Just a minor issue."

He calculated silently in his heart—the turtle shell's agitation was becoming more frequent, from several times a day initially to now striking every half an hour. This meant the compatibility between the Tianji Record Fragment and himself was approaching some critical threshold. Was awakening near, or... was counter-immersion coming?

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stopped in her tracks.

Under the moonlight, the girl's Inner Disciple Senior Fellow attire gleamed with a cold luster. She turned around, and those eyes that usually held scrutiny and wariness now flickered with an unnoticeable trace of worry: "You always do this, keeping everything bottled up inside."

She paused, lowering her voice even more: "The Sect Competition is three months away. What are you planning to do?"

These words made Chen Ji's footsteps halt slightly. The Sect Competition—of course he knew about this grand event. Tianqing Sect's selection held every five years, when all three major sects would gather, with Outer Disciples, Inner Disciples, and Core Disciples all competing on stage. And he, this "useless servant," was supposed to be the most insignificant speck of dust in the audience.

But someone wouldn't let him watch the show in peace.

text.content:
The next morning, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena.

This was a massive stone platform large enough to hold ten thousand people. The bluestone ground was covered with sword marks and formation rune patterns left by generations of founding ancestors. The morning mist had yet to dissipate, yet killing intent already filled the air—the final day for Sect Competition registration was today.

Chen Ji stood in the outermost corner of the crowd, his washed-out servant's robe fluttering gently in the wind. He looked utterly out of place among the spirited disciples around him, like a random splash of ink in an ink painting.

"Look, thattrash is here too!"

"Ha, he's not actually thinking of signing up, is he? Does he really think this grand event could make his fortune?"

"Dream on! With his level of cultivation, he probably can't even survive the first round of Outer Disciple matches!"

Whispers buzzed like a swarm of bees. Chen Ji kept his eyes down, as if hearing nothing, only his right hand unconsciously stroking the scorching turtle shell in his embrace.

On the high platform at the center of the Martial Arena, five figures sat upright—the five elders of the Tianqing Sect. In the center was Fifth Elder Ling Yuan. This seemingly kind old man was stroking his flower-white beard, his gaze sweeping across the dark mass of people below, finally pausing in a certain direction.

That momentary gaze, Chen Ji felt it.

Like a frog being stared at by a venomous snake, like a hunter examining his prey. The Fifth Elder's lips curved slightly upward, and that smile held something that sent a chill through Chen Ji's heart.

"SILENCE!"

The Fifth Elder raised his hand, his sonorous voice exploding like thunder: "The Sect Competition is our Tianqing Sect's grand event held once every five years. From today, registration closes and the roster is finalized. Three days later, the Competition officially begins!"

His gaze swept toward a certain corner in the crowd once more, his voice suddenly rising: "In this Competition, this seat specially wants to draw attention to one person—Servant Disciple, Chen Ji!"

dialogue.content:
The Fifth Elder's voice echoed above the Martial Arena, carrying an overwhelming authority: "Fellow disciples may not be aware, but this Chen Ji disciple, though a servant, has received the blessing of our sect's ancient sage, having acquired extraordinary divine abilities. This seat looks forward to his performance in the Competition."

At these words, the entire arena erupted.

"What? Sage's blessing?"

"Thattrash?"

"What's the Fifth Elder mean by this? Deliberately elevating him?"

"No, this is clearly setting him up for a fall!"

The murmurs in the crowd churned like boiling water, while Chen Ji standing in the corner merely lifted his head slightly, meeting the Fifth Elder's fathomless eyes.

Old fox.

Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart. The Fifth Elder's words seemed complimentary but actually pushed him to the eye of the storm. From today forward, everyone would be watching him, waiting for him to embarrass himself in the Competition—and if he showed any abnormality, those secretly watching eyes would swarm in like wolves scenting blood.

This move was vicious enough.

text.content:
Above the high platform, the Fifth Elder's gaze locked with Chen Ji's across the distance. The old man nodded slightly, that posture resembling an elder's concern for a younger one, but Chen Ji read another meaning in those eyes:

—Did you think you could hide?

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, lowering his eyelids. His expression remained calm, as if the person being called out publicly wasn't himself. The mocking, curious, or gloating eyes of the surrounding disciples fell upon him, but he seemed oblivious.

But his right hand had already quietly pressed against the turtle shell in his embrace.

Scalding hot.

Hotter than yesterday.

"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao had somehow walked to his side, the girl's voice pitched low, "The Fifth Elder is targeting you."

"I know." Chen Ji replied calmly.

"Then you—"

"Sign up." Chen Ji interrupted her, a noncommittal smile curving his lips, "Since the Fifth Elder has such high expectations, if I don't participate, wouldn't I be disappointing his kindness?"

Three days later, the Sect Competition officially began.

The Martial Arena was packed with people. Besides Tianqing Sect's own disciples, there were observers from the Xuanwu Sect and White Tiger Sect. The three major sects usually engaged in secret rivalry, but maintained superficial harmony at such grand events—at least under the watchful eyes of both elders, no one dared cause trouble.

Chen Ji stood at the very end of the line of competitors, surrounded by mocking or disdainful gazes. He deliberately restrained his aura, suppressing his cultivation to Qi Refining Third Stage—this matched his "trash" persona and everyone's expectations.

"Draw lots begin!"

Following the Law Enforcement Elder's command, competing disciples approached one by one to draw their match numbers from the jade box. Chen Ji was last in line. When he stepped forward, suppressed laughter rang out around him.

"Let's see who's the first-round opponent for our Competition's biggest joke?"

"Hope he doesn't embarrass himself too badly, after all, he's a 'genius' blessed by the sage, right?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji reached into the jade box, his fingertips touching a cool jade slip. He revealed the draw, and the Law Enforcement Elder's voice rang out: "Third match of the first round, Servant Disciple Chen Ji, versus—"

The elder's voice paused, his brow furrowing slightly.

"...Inner Disciple, Zhao Tieshan!"

At these words, the entire arena erupted once more.

Zhao Tieshan—this name was known to virtually every disciple present. He was the right-hand man of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie, his cultivation had reached Foundation Building Middle Stage, and with his god-given divine strength, he had defeated seven Tianqing Sect Inner Disciples in last year's sect exchange meeting.

And now, this monster had been arranged to face a "trash"?

"Ha! Who arranged this draw?" someone couldn't help laughing, "Isn't this obviously setting up thetrash for humiliation?"

"What do you know, this is called dramatic effect!" another person chimed in, "Give you hope first, then crush your despair—that's true humiliation!"

Chen Ji looked at the jade slip in his hand, his expression unchanged.

Foundation Building Middle Stage, eh...

He tucked the jade slip into his sleeve and turned toward the waiting area. The turtle shell in his embrace suddenly violently throbbed, as if something within was awakening.

text.content:
In the waiting area, Chen Ji found the most secluded corner and sat down.

He closed his eyes and delved his consciousness inward. The turtle shell's heat was rising at an unbelievable speed. The broken Tianji Record Fragment seemed awakened by some force, its surface patterns beginning to faintly glow.

At the same time, a blurry vision flashed through his mind—

On the arena platform, dust filled the sky. A tall figure stood opposite him, fist wind howling, carrying terrifying power enough to shatter stone and cleave gold. And he... seemed driven into a desperate corner.

The vision shifted.

He saw his right hand suddenly thrust forward, a point of golden light blooming in his palm. That golden light transformed into an invisible barrier,硬生生挡住了赵铁山的全力一击！

Then the vision dissolved.

Chen Ji violently opened his eyes, a layer of fine sweat beading on his forehead. The Tianji Record's foresight—each use consumed precious Heavenly Fate Value, and he now... how much remained?

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's foresight is complete. Now before you lies a critical choice: consume Heavenly Fate Value for victory, or continue hiding your strength?

choices.description: Pretend to be unable to compete in front of everyone, preserve your trump cards, let all continue mocking you as this "trash." Playing the pig to eat the tiger is the long-term strategy.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the secret of the Tianji Record, avoid exposing it too early
choices.risk_hint: If you act too convincingly, you might actually get injured

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his consciousness, a playful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.

He had long grown accustomed to mockery. Those gazes, those words, those self-righteous taunts—they were merely passing clouds to him. A true hunter never shows his fangs to his prey.

"Since the Fifth Elder has such expectations..." he murmured to himself, "then I'll give him exactly what he wants."

On the arena platform, the Law Enforcement Elder's voice rang out: "Third match of the first round, Servant Disciple Chen Ji versus Inner Disciple Zhao Tieshan! Both contestants, step up!"

choices.text: Release the power of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Let those who mocked you witness true power. Crush Zhao Tieshan, and tell everyone that atrash can also defy heaven!
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value, may attract attention from the powerful
choices.visible_reward: Shake the sect, make Han Lie lose face
choices.risk_hint: The secret of the Tianji Record may be exposed

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his gaze sweeping across the mocking and disdainful faces around him.

He recalled the vision just moments ago—he had seen the image of his counterattack. That was the guidance the Tianji Record gave him, and also his permission.

"Since everyone has such expectations..."

He walked toward the arena platform, his voice soft but clearly entering each person's ears.

"Then Chen will graciously accept."

At these words, the surroundings suddenly fell silent for a moment. Then, laughter surged like a tide—

"Hahaha! Thistrash actually dares to accept the challenge?"

"He's probably going to be punched off the platform with the first punch!"

"Let's watch the show!"

Chen Ji heard nothing, ascending the stone steps toward the arena platform.

On the arena platform, wind howled.

Chen Ji stood on the east side of the platform, while Zhao Tieshan stood on the west. The two were thirty zhang apart, but that invisible pressure had already thickened the air.

Zhao Tieshan was nearly a zhang tall, his muscles rippling, radiating the powerful aura distinctive of a Foundation Building Middle Stage cultivator. He looked at Chen Ji across from him, a contemptuous smile twisting his lips: "You? You're worthy of standing on this platform?"

Chen Ji didn't answer, merely slightly raising his chin, his gaze calm as a deep pool.

"Boy, be smart and admit defeat." Zhao Tieshan took a step forward, the earth trembling beneath him, "Otherwise when we start, I can't guarantee I won't accidentally kill you."

Below the platform, Su Qingyao's hands tightly gripped her clothes, her knuckles white. She knew Chen Ji was no ordinary person, but Zhao Tieshan's strength was摆在那里—Foundation Building Middle Stage for sure, while Chen Ji...

"BEGIN!"

The Law Enforcement Elder's command rang out, and Zhao Tieshan's body exploded forward like a moving mountain, bearing down on Chen Ji!

dialogue.content:
At this critical moment, a wild laugh echoed from below the arena platform.

"Hahaha! Zhao Tieshan, stop wasting time. Just blast that trash down with one punch!"

Everyone turned to look—the source was a muscular young man standing at the front row, arms crossed, his face filled with arrogance. It was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect—Han Lie.

"Chen Ji? That trash?" Han Lie glanced at the figure on the platform, sneering. "I thought he'd be some formidable opponent. Turns out he's just a joke."

His gaze swept across the crowd and finally landed on Su Qingyao. A playful curve formed at the corner of his mouth: "Senior Fellow Su Qingyao, why do you care so much about that trash? Could it be—"

"Shut up." Su Qingyao coldly cut him off. "Just watch your own match."

Han Lie shrugged, indifferent: "Fine, fine. I'll just wait and watch the show."

On the arena platform, Zhao Tieshan's iron fist was already carrying a howling wind toward Chen Ji's face!

text.content:
The fist wind struck his face, compressing the air into substance.

Chen Ji stood still, motionless, as if paralyzed by fear. Shouts rose from below—

"It's over! That trash is dead for sure!"

"He didn't even dodge. Has he lost his mind from fear?"

"What a waste of that face."

Su Qingyao's pupils constricted sharply. She instinctively stepped forward—

However, just as the iron fist was about to smash into Chen Ji's face, Chen Ji moved.

His right hand slowly rose. The movement appeared impossibly slow, yet it precisely blocked before Zhao Tieshan's fist. That seemingly frail palm was now like an immovable mountain, actually catching the punch powerful enough to shatter rocks! 

"What?!"

Zhao Tieshan's pupils constricted violently. He felt it—the strength coming from that palm far exceeded what a Qi Refining third layer should possess!

Below the arena, everyone froze in shock.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji displayed strength beyond the surface. Zhao Tieshan's expression changed drastically. This was a crucial moment of decision—

choices.text: Press the advantage and crush them thoroughly
choices.description: Give the opponent no chance to breathe. Explode with all your strength to beat Zhao Tieshan to the ground and let everyone see what a true genius looks like!
choices.visible_cost: Exposing too much strength may attract more attention
choices.visible_reward: Completely crush Zhao Tieshan, humiliating Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Displaying such stunning strength may draw the attention of powerful enemies

text.content:
A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes.

Since he'd already made his move, there was nothing left to hide.

His left hand suddenly shot out, five fingers like hooks, directly targeting Zhao Tieshan's throat! The speed was incredible, like a flash of lightning tearing through the sky!

Zhao Tieshan was terrified and scrambled backward to block. But Chen Ji was faster—the seemingly frail palm now moved like a spirit snake emerging from its lair, each strike precisely circumventing the opponent's defense and landing on the most lethal points!

"Bang!"

A palm struck Zhao Tieshan's chest. The tremendous force made this Foundation Building mid-stage cultivator groan, stumbling backward.

"Impossible!" Zhao Tieshan's eyes widened, his face full of disbelief. "You're clearly just—"

Before he could finish, Chen Ji had already closed in again. This time, a faint golden light was gathering in the center of his palm!

choices.description: Only reveal part of your strength. Let Zhao Tieshan知难而退 (retreat when he sees the difficulty). Maintain an air of mystery so enemies can't gauge your true depth.
choices.visible_cost: May be considered a stroke of luck
choices.visible_reward: Stay low-key and avoid drawing excessive attention

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his palm and stepped back.

His expression remained calm, as if that exchange had been a trivial matter.

"Senior Brother Zhao, you've been too kind." He said coolly. "There's a vast gap between our strengths. Continuing will only harm our harmony. Why not call it a draw?"

These words sounded humble and polite, but to everyone's ears, they carried a different meaning—分明是在说「你打不过我，我不想让你太难看」! (Clearly saying 'You can't beat me, I just don't want to embarrass you too much'!)

Zhao Tieshan's face flushed to the color of pork liver. He, a Foundation Building mid-stage master, was being asked to make peace by 'trash' in public?

"You dare seek death!"

He roared and charged again, this time with even more fierce attacks, his blood and qi surging, clearly using some secret technique!

But Chen Ji merely shook his head slightly, a trace of disappointment flickering in his eyes.

"You've refused the courtesy wine, so now you'll drink the penalty wine."

Right at that moment, a sudden change occurred.

The turtle shell in Chen Ji's arms suddenly let out a clear humming sound. Though not loud, it seemed to resonate directly in everyone's mind. At the same time, a golden light, barely visible to the naked eye, emerged from the turtle shell, racing along Chen Ji's meridians!

"This is..."

Chen Ji looked down at his chest. A cluster of light was slowly gathering there. Golden patterns spread across his skin like vines, carrying an ancient and mysterious rhythm.

The Tianji Record... was awakening!

An old voice rang in his mind—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice:

"The time has come. The first page's seal is released."

Golden light blazed brilliantly!

Chen Ji下意识地 (instinctively) raised his right hand. A complex rune appeared in his palm, radiating scorching light and resonating with the patterns on the turtle shell.

And opposite him, Zhao Tieshan's fist was already carrying the momentum of destruction as it came roaring over!

Golden light and iron fist collided in mid-air.

"BOOM!!"

A deafening roar shook the arena. Violent waves of energy swept outward from the two of them. The blue stone tiles on the platform shattered one after another. Dust filled the sky, obscuring everyone's vision!

"Wh-What happened?!"

"What's that golden light?!"

"What did Chen Ji that trash do?!"

When the dust settled, everyone finally saw the scene on the platform.

Chen Ji still stood where he was, not even stepping back a single inch. His right hand was raised high, palm facing outward, that cluster of golden light slowly rotating in his hand. And Zhao Tieshan—

That Foundation Building mid-stage master, nearly a zhang tall, was now kneeling on the ground. His arms were twisted, blood seeping through his fingers. His face was full of terror and disbelief, his lips trembling but unable to produce any sound.

One punch.

Just one punch.

In a single exchange, Zhao Tieshan had been beaten to the point of being unable to fight!

A deathly silence fell over the entire arena.

Everyone stood frozen, staring at that lean figure on the platform as if witnessing something impossible. Those who had mocked Chen Ji now only felt a burning pain on their faces.

"This... how is this possible?"

"Zhao Tieshan is Foundation Building mid-stage! How could he..."

"That trash... no, who exactly is he?!"

Below the platform, Han Lie's expression had turned as dark as dripping water. His fists were clenched tightly, his knuckles white from the force.

Zhao Tieshan was his confidant, his right-hand man whom he had personally elevated. And now, this confidant had been defeated in one punch by someone he called 'trash'—this was essentially slapping his face in public!

"Chen Ji..." Han Lie ground out the name through clenched teeth, a venomous light flickering in his eyes. "I'll remember you."

And above, on the high platform, the Fifth Elder Ling Yuan's eyes narrowed slightly, his gaze filled with profound meaning.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stood in the crowd, her chest heaving violently.

She looked at that familiar yet unfamiliar figure on the platform, her heart churning with indescribable emotions. Shock, confusion, relief... and a trace of inexplicable flutter.

"So... he was hiding his strength all along." She murmured softly. "Playing the weak to eat the strong... what deep scheming."

She recalled how she had come close to the truth three times, and three times Chen Ji had deflected her. At the time, she thought it was her imagination. Now it seemed... 

"How many secrets is this man still hiding?"

On the platform, the Law Enforcement Elder finally came to his senses. He looked at Zhao Tieshan kneeling on the ground in agony, then at Chen Ji standing motionless, and after a long while, managed to speak:

"First round, third match... Servant Disciple Chen Ji, victory!"

The voice echoed above the Martial Arena, yet it was like a stone thrown into stagnant water, stirring no ripple. Because everyone's attention was still fixed on that proudly standing figure.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had achieved victory, but reactions among the crowd varied. This was a crucial moment—

choices.description: Use words to severely humiliate this person who once looked down on you. Make him lose face completely and let everyone know you're not to be trifled with!
choices.visible_cost: May come across as arrogant and make more enemies
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly crush the opponent's psychology and embarrass Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Harsh words may provoke deeper hatred

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly walked to Zhao Tieshan, looking down at this once invincible壮汉 from above.

"Zhao Shixiong," his voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, "you just told me to concede?"

Zhao Tieshan raised his head, his facial muscles contorted with pain and humiliation.

Chen Ji smiled faintly, a smile that appeared particularly jarring in everyone's eyes: "What a pity, I have one flaw—I really don't like being threatened."

He squatted down to meet Zhao Tieshan's eyes: "Foundation Building middle stage? Han Lie's right-hand man? In my eyes, you're nothing but worthless trash."

At these words, the entire arena erupted in shock.

This was clearly no "waste"! This was pure arrogance pushed to the extreme!

choices.text: Keep a low profile and leave
choices.description: Victory has proven everything. There's no need to linger. Wave my sleeves without taking even a wisp of cloud. Let others speculate.
choices.visible_cost: Missed an opportunity to show off
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery, making enemies even more wary
choices.risk_hint: Might be considered a fluke victory

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't look at Zhao Tieshan again.

He only lightly brushed off the nonexistent dust from his robe, then turned to walk toward the edge of the Arena Platform. That slender, composed back seemed to suggest that everything just transpired was merely a trivial matter.

"Wait!" Zhao Tieshan struggled to stand, "You... who exactly are you?!"

Chen Ji's steps paused, yet he didn't turn around.

"Me?" His voice was calm, carrying a hint of nonchalance, "I'm merely a Servant Disciple."

With that, he leapt down from the Arena Platform and vanished into the crowd.

All that remained were shocked stares and countless hearts shaken beyond repair.

After the crowd dispersed, Chen Ji walked alone on the Mountain Path back to his quarters.

His right hand still felt faintly warm. Though the golden light had vanished, the resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and himself had clearly deepened significantly. It felt like a door long sealed had cracked open slightly, revealing a far grander world beyond.

"The first page's seal is broken..." he murmured to himself, "Is this merely the beginning?"

He raised his eyes to gaze at the distant high platform. Fifth Elder Ling Yuan had departed at some point, yet that scrutinizing gaze seemed to linger in the air like an invisible thorn.

In another direction, Han Lie watched his departing figure with a dark expression, dangerous glints flickering in his eyes.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly.

The Sect Competition had just begun.

And the Turtle Shell nestled against his chest was growing warmer by the moment—as if something within was gradually awakening.
